callback.name: Stay in touch
callback.text: You promised {contact} to be in touch again soon.

dinner.name: A dinner owed
dinner.text: You promised {contact} a proper dinner — soon, and in person.

intro.name: An introduction
intro.text: You promised {contact} to open a door to someone in your circle.

first_look.name: A first look
first_look.text: You promised {contact} a first look when something worthwhile crosses your desk.

notables.name: Financier A. Rothmere
notables.desc: Old money with a taste for pictures — half a slate can hang on his nod.

notables.name: Attorney M. Vogel
notables.desc: The lawyer the studios call before they call each other. Makes problems disappear.

notables.name: Society hostess V. Harcourt
notables.desc: Her dinner table seats twelve — and decides half the town's friendships.

notables.name: Press baron C. Whitlock
notables.desc: Owns the morning edition and, with it, tomorrow's truth.

notables.name: Producer legend O. Steiner
notables.desc: Three decades of hits. Returns calls only for people he has been introduced to.

call.name: Phone call
call.desc: Fast, direct, fairly discreet — but with no time to think, gaffes happen.

meet.name: Meeting/Dinner
meet.desc: Strongest relationship effect — costs time, travel, and a good restaurant.

note.name: Message
note.desc: Precise and asynchronous — but it can be forwarded or leaked.

letter.name: Letter
letter.desc: Slow and formal — arrives days later, but a considered page outweighs ten wires.

gift.name: Gift
gift.desc: Personal and effective — with a cool contact it quickly feels inappropriate.

aide.name: Send assistant
aide.desc: Saves your time — but people remember that you did not come yourself.

club.name: Private club
club.desc: Confidential: favors, tips and promises are born here — and rumors about you.
